notes.title: ANIMO Stars Arena Developer Update v0.2.0
notes.content:
[u][h1]New Features[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794956/3b723845bdffa555e7829f2929518393e3c23521.png[/img]
[h2]Pilots Everywhere![/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve taken pilots out of their mechs and into the HUB where you will be able to interact with different features (i.e. game start, mech customization). 
[/list]
[h2]Loadouts[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve added the ability to pre-configure and save mech presets for quick deployment during gameplay. 
[*] You will be able to save up to 6 unique loadouts. 
[*] Each loadout consists of a cabin, engine, left/right item, bumper, and theme
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794956/bbad4a2a93c22423f7f73d1589b3c0df30e39b41.png[/img]
[h2]Firing range[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a firing range to the HUB where you will be able to test various mech loadouts and weapons.
[/list]
[h2]“Buzz-B”[/h2]
[list]
[*] A lightning bolt weapon. If an enemy is hit it will bounce to nearby enemies in a chain of damage to deal 80% of maximum damage to damage a maximum of 3 additional enemies. 
[/list]
[h2]Account System[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve now created a new ANIMO account system for users to connect their various accounts (i.e. steam, epic, and blockchain wallet) to sync all of the users data 
[/list]
[h2]Emotes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Emotes are animations that pilots perform in-game. If the emote is activated while in the mech the pilot will pop out during the emote.
[/list]
[h2]Stickers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stickers are emojis players can use in-game to communicate with other players.
[/list]
[u][h1]UX/UI UPDATES[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794956/d100da8b3487da2a109d11c03f65296e7951f960.png[/img]
[h2]Pre/Post-Game Screens[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve made significant changes to the pre and post-game screens to include player names and game statistics 
[/list]
[h2]HUD[/h2]
[olist]
[*] New overall look! Adjustments to in-game HUD such as ammo indicators and currently equipped weapons
[/olist]
[h2]Mech Loadout Screen[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a widget to display current loadout’s attributes (i.e. weapon damage, health, armor, speed, class) with comparison features. 
[*] Can equip/change abilities (Dash/Shield/Mortar)
[/list]
[h2]In-Game Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Direction marker for tank movement to help users keep track of forward movement 
[*] Pilot head movement: pilots will now look towards nearby enemies 
[*] Visuals align with damage collision to match rendered mesh 
[*] Height fog is now added 
[/list]
[u][h1]Balancing Updates[/h1][/u]
[u][h2]Movement Updates[/h2][/u]
[h2]Sprinting/Boost[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added maximum duration and recharge delay
[/list]
[h2]Jump[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tanks have 1  jump charge, while walking mechs have 2 jump charges
[*] Added a 0.15 second cooldown to jumping to avoid instant double jumping
[*] Adjusted movement with jumping to allow for higher precision mid-air 
[/list]
[u][h2]Weapon Updates[/h2][/u]
[h2]Sword[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sword damage increased to 120
[/list]
[h2]Skyhammer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Laser damage reworked to be applied every 0.25 seconds
[*] Laser damage will start at 10, then increase to 15 after 2 seconds of continuous firing.  Finally, after an additional 2 seconds of continuous firing, the damage will then increase to a maximum of 22 damage. 
[*] Laser damage will initially start as a yellow laser (starting damage) then change to orange (middle damage) and then to red (maximum damage)
[*] Maximum firing time is set to 8 seconds. If exceeded, there will be a 4 second cooldown.
[*] The weapon will go to automatic cooldown after 1.5 seconds of non-continuous use (while within maximum firing window)
[/list]
[h2]Critical Damage[/h2]
[list]
[*] Critical damage now applicable only to headshots. Note: Does not apply for lasers, hookshot, swords, or flamethrowers.
[*] Getting hit while doing an emote will cause 2x Critical Damage. Careful with the bm!
[*] Armor
[*] Damage to opponent mechs is now calculated based on opponent armor and other attributes
[/list]
[u][h1]Ability System Updates[/h1][/u]
[h2]Dash [/h2]
[list]
[*] Players now hold 2 dash charges that recharge every 10 seconds
[*] Dash will now follow most recent movement input from player (i.e. dash left with left movement)
[/list]
[h2]Shield[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can deploy a spherical shield to protect themselves for 4 seconds
[/list]
[h2]Mortar[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fires a projectile that denotes after 2 seconds and causes a “knock-back” area of effect to opponents and applies small damage
[/list]
[u][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/u]
[h2]Wall Collision Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed collision mechanics that caused “wall-running” 
[/list]
[h2]Charge Rifle SFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed “beeps” when used
[/list]
[h2]Flamethrower[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed bug where flamethrower would continue to fire even after releasing fire button
[/list]
[h2]Weapons Swap[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed bug where weapons swap visually but would not swap weapon fx/features until user died
[/list]

notes.title: ANIMO Stars Arena Development Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Happy Monday! We wanted to give you all an update on how things have been going the last few weeks behind the scenes!

[h2]New Game Developers[/h2]
We were fortunate enough to have found 3 new game devs to help us and we just recently onboarded them. 
- 2 of them are unreal engine developers and will help us tackle some of those tasks I mentioned before!  
- 1 game dev will help us make the UI/UX and focus on the overall player experience 

[h2]Game Sprint Tasks[/h2]
We will try to keep you all updated moving forward on some of the bug/development updates that the team will be working on. They're not always exciting but we wanted to give you all a peak into what is going on: 
-Website development (we're going to be giving our [url=https://animo.art/]https://animo.art/[/url] a facelift soon)
-In-game UI/HUD update
-Charge Rifle SFX
-Adjusting boost on the walking mechs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794956/8d38858b06287d96d21706748c86fa498faa425b.gif[/img]

[h2]Art dev updates[/h2]
As most of you are aware our amazing art development team Mech + Tooty are working primarily on game assets and also on future assets which we will integrate in the game. 

For those of you whom are newer or have just forgotten we will be featuring a "battle pass" in the game (think fortnite or COD or apex) where you will be able to progress your battle pass to unlock new skins. Consequently the art team currently is focused on creating the assets for future battle pass seasons. 

I won't leak too much but let's just say all the pilots that you all keep asking about, there will be new ones. Cute & cuddly pilots. Suits for the pilots. New weapons. New themes. 

[h2]Future Events[/h2]
We are currently in the process of planning and curating a list of gaming events that we want to attend and be featured in. Many of these will be virtual similar to Steam Next Fest so we will let you all know details whenever we finalize some of them!

[h2]Questions?[/h2]
Feel free to ask here in our community hub or on our discord!

notes.title: October Development Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Steam Next Fest Re-Cap[/b][/h1]
First of all, thanks everyone for coming out and participating in the Steam Next Fest activities! We've had quite a lot of new wishlists and game downloads through the event. 

Our game trailer also netted ~30K views on our social media platforms and we were featured on IGN! 

[url=https://www.ign.com/videos/animo-stars-arena-official-gameplay-reveal-trailer]https://www.ign.com/videos/animo-stars-arena-official-gameplay-reveal-trailer[/url]

[h1]ANIMO Stars Arena Game Updates[/h1]
[b]GAME ADJUSTMENTS/UPDATES[/b]
There were quite a few excellent suggestions that the community gave us regarding improvements to our demo we featured at steam next fest! 

The dev team just recently started another sprint to start tackling some of those things. 

Some of the upcoming tasks include: 
1) Updating the UI/UX
2) Reworking the ability system
3) Adjusting the movement/boost system
4) Adjusting/revamping some of the weapon fx

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794956/f2adb4d7f2f3f4e822c79fac95cf1aeeb1d31c3e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794956/f2adb4d7f2f3f4e822c79fac95cf1aeeb1d31c3e.gif[/img][/url]

[b]FUTURE FEATURES OF THE GAME [/b]
We plan to start adding more of our game modes moving forward: think capture the flag, etc... and we also will be developing different maps for you all to play on (small close quarter combat vs medium sized map)!

[b]EXPANDING THE TEAM[/b]
For those of you new to the community, the game development team is currently comprised of the core members/founders and all the work is being done in-house. We are currently working on finding additional game engineers/devs to help expedite our development process! 

[h1]Questions?[/h1]
We're always available to discuss any questions on our community hub or in our discord!
